f32-vs-f32.description: Both sides compute in float32 over identical decoded checkpoint values and differ only in summation order.
f32-vs-f32.derivation: One float32 ULP at a logit magnitude of 32 is 3.8e-6. Inkling 2 Mini executes 48 layer slots whose widest reductions sum about 2,304 terms; a random-walk bound over sqrt(48 x 2304) ~ 330 independent roundings gives about 1.3e-3, so max_abs is 1e-3 per logit and mean_abs 1e-4. For small logit perturbations d, KL is about Var_p(d)/2 <= max_abs^2/2 = 5e-7 per position (bound 1e-6) and mean_abs^2/2 = 5e-9 on average (bound 1e-8).
